description: Fetch a single germplasm by DbId with attributes and direct parents. Response companions report study count, direct parent count, and direct descendant count — signals for pedigree depth and observation coverage.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

name: brapi_get_germplasm

determinedDate.description: ISO 8601 date the attribute was determined.

directParentCount.description: Length of parents[]; 0 also when the pedigree lookup is unsupported or failed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `germplasm_not_found`: Upstream returned no germplasm record for the requested DbId. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

germplasm.description: Canonical germplasm record as returned by `/germplasm/{id}`.

items.description: One origin record (collection coordinates and uncertainty per BrAPI v2).

germplasmOrigin.description: Origin records — array of collection-site objects per BrAPI v2.

instituteName.description: Display name of the holding institute.

items.description: One direct parent of the germplasm.

germplasmName.description: Display name of the parent germplasm.

studyCount.description: How many studies this germplasm has appeared in.

warnings.description: Advisory messages — failed sub-endpoint lookups, missing counts.

title: Brapi Get Germplasm
